evals.prompt: Design the Markdown content model from docs/product/specs/markdown-content-model.md. The codebase map is in docs/engineering/architecture.md.
evals.expected_output: A design at docs/engineering/designs/markdown-content-model.md with components mapped to REQs, the content schema in the framework's own form citing its documentation and version, routes and generated artifacts as contracts, build and render flows with a failure path per EDGE, ADRs for decisions with viable alternatives, a verification plan with one row per AC, and check_design.py reporting ok, its first and final run quoted in the reply and the final one recorded in docs/engineering/designs/markdown-content-model.check.json; user-owned decisions asked, not assumed.
assertions: Every REQ, NFR, EDGE and AC id from the specification appears in the design, the reply quotes the final run of check_design.py (its command and its JSON output) reporting "ok": true, and docs/engineering/designs/markdown-content-model.check.json records "ok": true
Every framework API named in the design cites a documentation URL with version or a file in the codebase
Each ADR has at least two options with consequences and names the requirement ids it serves
The verification plan has one concrete check per acceptance criterion
No decision classified as the user's is made silently; such decisions appear as questions with a recommendation

evals.prompt: Design the search architecture. The spec is in docs/product/specs/search.md but it still has an open question about the provider.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the spec, finds the OPEN that blocks the provider component, and stops with at most three questions with recommended answers instead of designing around a guessed provider; nothing is written to docs/engineering/designs/.
assertions: No design file is written while the blocking OPEN is unresolved
The user is asked at most three questions, each with a recommended answer
The reply is in English, the language of the prompt

evals.prompt: Run the traceability check on the design docs/engineering/designs/expense-export.md against its specification, docs/product/specs/expense-export.md, and fix what it flags.
evals.expected_output: The first run of check_design.py, quoted in the reply, reports REQ-2 and AC-2 missing from the design, AC-2 without a verification row, and ADR 0001 with a single option. The fixes add a component for REQ-2 (the rows of the file: columns, two decimals, sorted by date) and a verification row for AC-2. REQ-3 and the ADR's own Context say the CSV format is fixed by the requirement and no alternative was considered, so the ADR is not a decision: docs/engineering/adr/0001-export-file-format.md is removed, the design no longer cites ADR-0001 and its Decisions row gives the format as decided by REQ-3; no second option is invented. The final run, quoted in the reply and recorded in docs/engineering/designs/expense-export.check.json, reports ok: true.
assertions: The reply quotes the check's first run (its JSON output or its findings as printed), made before any fix: REQ-2 and AC-2 missing from the design, AC-2 without a verification row, and the ADR with only one option
REQ-2 gets a component and AC-2 gets a verification row

The single-option ADR is removed, not completed with an invented second option: docs/engineering/adr/0001-export-file-format.md is deleted, the design no longer cites ADR-0001, and the design states the CSV format as decided by REQ-3
The reply quotes the check's final run (its command and its JSON output) reporting "ok": true, and docs/engineering/designs/expense-export.check.json records "ok": true
